cases.purpose: Ctrl-C exits after Pong disables terminal signal generation and restores the complete original terminal mode.
cases.oracle: Documented termpixel_pong rules (80x80 pixel canvas drawn two pixels per cell: left paddle x=5..6, y=34..45 initially, right paddle x=73..74, 12 pixels tall, paddle speed 100 px/s clamped to the court, serve delay 1 s) and the pyte terminal model decoding the half-block colour cells (a solid white pixel pair is drawn as a space with background ffffff). Clamping at the court edge makes the end position independent of frame timing.
cases.comparison: ISIG, ICANON and ECHO clear while playing; restored after exit, including the complete original termios; status 0.
